checks.why: a script with a python shebang and no .py extension is a module: the function it calls has it as a caller, and it is not listed among the files the index does not read as source
a shell script that only runs python3 is not read as Python: its mention of the function stays a text match, not a caller
an edit inside a shebang script names the function it changed, so test-impact has a declaration to start from
